name: App directory (every framework app, and a picker for hosts)
description: The framework's app directory (app-directory@1: every web app built with or for AmberX that has a home on the web, generated from the project manifests' deploy.url + x.app and external.json) and an app picker: switch apps on or off, put them in order, add your own (https only). Patches uses it to choose its tabs; the console's App tabs plugin reads the same list. Harvested Oct 23 2026 from Patches and the App tabs plugin.

parts.label: Add your own apps
parts.description: A form under the list adds any https site (or AXF app) by name and address.

parts.label: Put apps in order
parts.description: Up / down buttons on every picked app.
